svg.title: What a code tool and a strict answer schema do
svg.desc: On the 84-task expert set: ling-3.0-flash 40.5 percent without and 96.4 percent with the harness; Claude Haiku 5.5 91.7 percent without and 100.0 percent with the harness; DeepSeek Flash 92.9 percent without and 97.6 percent with the harness.
